package config

import (
	"errors"
	"net"

	"github.com/kelseyhightower/envconfig"
)

// Config holds service configuration.
type Config struct {
	LegacyPracticeRuntimeWritesEnabled   bool   `envconfig:"LEGACY_PRACTICE_RUNTIME_WRITES_ENABLED" default:"false"`
	HTTPBindAddress                      string `envconfig:"HTTP_BIND_ADDRESS" default:""`
	HTTPPort                             string `envconfig:"HTTP_PORT" default:"8081"`
	DatabaseURL                          string `envconfig:"DATABASE_URL" default:"postgres://postgres:postgres@localhost:5437/student?sslmode=disable"`
	NATSURL                              string `envconfig:"NATS_URL" default:"nats://localhost:4222"`
	CourseServiceBaseURL                 string `envconfig:"COURSE_SERVICE_BASE_URL" default:"http://localhost:8080"`
	CourseServiceInternalToken           string `envconfig:"COURSE_SERVICE_INTERNAL_TOKEN" default:"change-me"`
	CourseDiagnosticCatalogToken         string `envconfig:"COURSE_DIAGNOSTIC_CATALOG_TOKEN" default:""`
	LearningPlannerInternalToken         string `envconfig:"LEARNING_PLANNER_INTERNAL_TOKEN" default:""`
	TeacherInternalToken                 string `envconfig:"TEACHER_INTERNAL_TOKEN" default:""`
	TeacherOnboardingTurnV2Enabled       bool   `envconfig:"TEACHER_ONBOARDING_TURN_V2_ENABLED" default:"false"`
	OnboardingPathAdmissionEnabled       bool   `envconfig:"STUDENT_ONBOARDING_PATH_ADMISSION_ENABLED" default:"false"`
	LearningWorkspaceSnapshotEnabled     bool   `envconfig:"STUDENT_LEARNING_WORKSPACE_SNAPSHOT_ENABLED" default:"false"`
	UserServiceBaseURL                   string `envconfig:"USER_SERVICE_BASE_URL" default:"http://localhost:8082"`
	ShutdownTimeout                      int    `envconfig:"SHUTDOWN_TIMEOUT" default:"10"`
	SandboxServiceBaseURL                string `envconfig:"SANDBOX_SERVICE_BASE_URL" default:"http://localhost:8080"`
	SandboxServiceInternalToken          string `envconfig:"SANDBOX_SERVICE_INTERNAL_TOKEN" default:"change-me"`
	FileStorageURL                       string `envconfig:"FILE_STORAGE_URL" default:"http://localhost:8082"`
	FileStorageInternalToken             string `envconfig:"FILESTORAGE_INTERNAL_TOKEN" default:""`
	PracticeTaskPublicationEncryptionKey string `envconfig:"PRACTICE_TASK_PUBLICATION_ENCRYPTION_KEY" default:""`
	HTMLValidatorURL                     string `envconfig:"HTML_VALIDATOR_URL" default:""`
	HTMLValidatorSubject                 string `envconfig:"HTML_VALIDATOR_SUBJECT" default:"validator.html.validate"`
	CSSValidatorSubject                  string `envconfig:"CSS_VALIDATOR_SUBJECT" default:"styles.validate.request"`
	PHPValidatorURL                      string `envconfig:"PHP_VALIDATOR_URL" default:""` // Optional HTTP(S) origin; the adapter owns /api/v1.
	NodeValidatorURL                     string `envconfig:"NODE_VALIDATOR_URL" default:""`
	ReactValidatorURL                    string `envconfig:"REACT_VALIDATOR_URL" default:""`
	ValidationOrchestratorURL            string `envconfig:"VALIDATION_ORCHESTRATOR_URL" default:""`
	ValidationOrchestratorInternalToken  string `envconfig:"VALIDATION_ORCHESTRATOR_INTERNAL_TOKEN" default:"change-me"`
	PracticeRuntimeURL                   string `envconfig:"PRACTICE_RUNTIME_URL" default:""`
	PracticeRuntimeInternalToken         string `envconfig:"PRACTICE_RUNTIME_INTERNAL_TOKEN" default:""`
	PracticeTaskOrchestratorURL          string `envconfig:"PRACTICE_TASK_ORCHESTRATOR_URL" default:""`
	PracticeTaskInternalToken            string `envconfig:"PRACTICE_TASK_INTERNAL_TOKEN" default:"change-me-practice"`
	AIPromptServiceURL                   string `envconfig:"AI_PROMPT_SERVICE_URL" default:""`
	AIPromptInternalToken                string `envconfig:"AI_PROMPT_INTERNAL_TOKEN" default:"change-me"`
	OutboxBatchSize                      int    `envconfig:"OUTBOX_BATCH_SIZE" default:"50"`
	OutboxLockTTLSeconds                 int    `envconfig:"OUTBOX_LOCK_TTL_SECONDS" default:"300"`
	OutboxPollIntervalMS                 int    `envconfig:"OUTBOX_POLL_INTERVAL_MS" default:"250"`
	OutboxRetryBaseSeconds               int    `envconfig:"OUTBOX_RETRY_BASE_SECONDS" default:"1"`
	OutboxRetryMaxSeconds                int    `envconfig:"OUTBOX_RETRY_MAX_SECONDS" default:"300"`
	OutboxPublishTimeoutSeconds          int    `envconfig:"OUTBOX_PUBLISH_TIMEOUT_SECONDS" default:"5"`
}

// Validate rejects values that would invalidate outbox leases or retry timing.
func (cfg Config) Validate() error {
	if cfg.OutboxBatchSize <= 0 || cfg.OutboxLockTTLSeconds <= 0 || cfg.OutboxPollIntervalMS <= 0 ||
		cfg.OutboxRetryBaseSeconds <= 0 || cfg.OutboxRetryMaxSeconds < cfg.OutboxRetryBaseSeconds ||
		cfg.OutboxPublishTimeoutSeconds <= 0 {
		return errors.New("outbox batch size and durations must be positive")
	}
	if cfg.LearningPlannerInternalToken != "" &&
		cfg.LearningPlannerInternalToken == cfg.CourseServiceInternalToken {
		return errors.New("LEARNING_PLANNER_INTERNAL_TOKEN must differ from COURSE_SERVICE_INTERNAL_TOKEN")
	}
	if cfg.CourseDiagnosticCatalogToken == "" {
		return errors.New("COURSE_DIAGNOSTIC_CATALOG_TOKEN is required for official diagnostics")
	}
	if cfg.CourseDiagnosticCatalogToken == cfg.CourseServiceInternalToken || cfg.CourseDiagnosticCatalogToken == cfg.LearningPlannerInternalToken || cfg.CourseDiagnosticCatalogToken == cfg.TeacherInternalToken || cfg.CourseDiagnosticCatalogToken == cfg.PracticeTaskInternalToken {
		return errors.New("COURSE_DIAGNOSTIC_CATALOG_TOKEN must differ from all Student internal tokens")
	}
	if cfg.TeacherInternalToken != "" &&
		(cfg.TeacherInternalToken == cfg.CourseServiceInternalToken || cfg.TeacherInternalToken == cfg.LearningPlannerInternalToken) {
		return errors.New("TEACHER_INTERNAL_TOKEN must differ from other inbound internal tokens")
	}
	if (cfg.TeacherOnboardingTurnV2Enabled || cfg.LearningWorkspaceSnapshotEnabled) && cfg.TeacherInternalToken == "" {
		return errors.New("TEACHER_ONBOARDING_TURN_V2_ENABLED and STUDENT_LEARNING_WORKSPACE_SNAPSHOT_ENABLED require TEACHER_INTERNAL_TOKEN")
	}
	if cfg.OnboardingPathAdmissionEnabled && cfg.LearningPlannerInternalToken == "" {
		return errors.New("STUDENT_ONBOARDING_PATH_ADMISSION_ENABLED requires LEARNING_PLANNER_INTERNAL_TOKEN")
	}
	if cfg.PracticeTaskInternalToken == "" {
		return errors.New("PRACTICE_TASK_INTERNAL_TOKEN is required for practice learning actions")
	}
	if cfg.PracticeTaskInternalToken == cfg.CourseServiceInternalToken ||
		cfg.PracticeTaskInternalToken == cfg.LearningPlannerInternalToken ||
		cfg.PracticeTaskInternalToken == cfg.TeacherInternalToken {
		return errors.New("PRACTICE_TASK_INTERNAL_TOKEN must differ from other inbound internal tokens")
	}
	minimumLeaseSeconds := int64(cfg.OutboxBatchSize) * int64(cfg.OutboxPublishTimeoutSeconds)
	if int64(cfg.OutboxLockTTLSeconds) <= minimumLeaseSeconds {
		return errors.New("OUTBOX_LOCK_TTL_SECONDS must cover the sequential batch publish timeout")
	}
	return nil
}

// HTTPListenAddress keeps the existing all-interface default while allowing a
// deployment adapter to select a specific host address, such as loopback.
func (cfg Config) HTTPListenAddress() string {
	return net.JoinHostPort(cfg.HTTPBindAddress, cfg.HTTPPort)
}

// Load reads configuration from env vars.
func Load() (Config, error) {
	var cfg Config
	err := envconfig.Process("", &cfg)
	return cfg, err
}
